The license terms are restrictive: we may hold exactly one in-person public screening, we may NOT publish any trailer or excerpt online, and we must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive'. I haven't added the license summary to the programming file yet because the signed copy arrived in my separate clearance inbox, but the terms are confirmed.

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue with 'After the Floodlights.' Today I checked the filmmaker's signed premiere declaration against our festival database and confirmed that the film already had a public screening at the Harbor Documentary Week. This means it fails the competition's unpublished-premiere requirement. It cannot remain in competition — if we retain it at all, it would have to be offered as a single special screening instead. I haven't updated the submission record yet because the database correction queue is still open, but the premiere status is confirmed.
